scientific_integrity: Proof is fully stated and corroborated by standalone exact finite checks, without claiming independent verification or exhaustive priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Binary words of even length with exactly two ones only; distinct root words, not shuffling colorings; no higher-weight or larger-alphabet assertion. The total two-one shuffle-square count is established prior work (2023); the claimed contribution is the inverse root multiplicity spectrum and limit law.
title: Root-multiplicity spectrum and triangular limiting law for binary two-one shuffle squares
